tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The NETGEAR WAX625 AX5400 Dual-Band Multi-Gig Wi-Fi 6 Access Point is a high-performance, business-class wireless solution designed for offices, enterprises, educational institutions, hotels, and high-density environments. Powered by Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) technology, it delivers ultra-fast speeds, improved capacity, and reliable connectivity for modern networks.


With a 2.5G Multi-Gig PoE+ Ethernet port, the WAX625 fully utilizes high-speed internet and switch infrastructure, ensuring maximum throughput and reduced network congestion. It supports cloud management via NETGEAR Insight, allowing easy remote monitoring and configuration from anywhere.


Key Features


  • AX5400 Wi-Fi 6 Speed – High-speed wireless performance for multiple users and devices
  • Dual-Band Technology – Operates on both 2.4GHz and 5GHz bands
  • 2.5G Multi-Gig PoE+ Port – Faster wired uplink with power and data over one cable
  • Wi-Fi 6 Technologies – OFDMA and MU-MIMO for better efficiency and capacity
  • Enterprise-Grade Security – Supports WPA3, VLANs, and multiple SSIDs
  • NETGEAR Insight Cloud Management – Easy setup, monitoring, and control
  • Mesh-Ready Design – Seamless roaming with other NETGEAR Insight access points
  • Ceiling & Wall Mountable – Clean and flexible installation options
